main_text.l: facit, ut Regiæ mensæ adhibeat, & familiares
cum eo miscere sermones: de quo ipsi jactant
Jesuitæ quòd speculū habeat constellatū, quo
quidquid Rex scire aueat, perspicuè ipsi repræ-
sentet. nec esse tam abstrusum, aut geri & con-
sultari in reliquorum Monachorū & Mona-
charūm intimis conclauibus, quod illius con-
stellati, vel potius condiabolati, speculi bene-
ficio, non in lucem proferre possit. Et quidem
huius Jesuitæ Magi opera confisi funt Jesuitæ
potentissimum quendam Imperii principem,
cumq; Euangelicum, in partes suas pertrahere,
quandoquidem is Magico studio mirificè de-
lectatus fuisse dicebatur. Quos verò inter se
Nouitios huic artificio perdiscendo deputa-
runt, iis explicant nongentas illas Propositio-
nes, quas Mirandulanus ille comes Romæ af-
fixit: item Johannis Trittenii librum: item
Cornelii Agrippæ tractatum de occulta Philo-
sophia: item Theophrastum de constellatione
& figillis Planetarum: item nescio cuius Ab-
batis Steganographiam: item artem Pauli ad
conciliandas reuelationes. ubi divum illum
Paulum intelligunt, quem dicunt arte quadâ
Magica instructum, tantas percepisse divin-
i-tus reuelationes. eademq; calluisse dicunt
& Johannem, imò Christum ipsum omnibus nu-
meris absolutissimum fuisse Magum non du-
bitant, ut egomet ab ipsis non semel audiui &
nominare possum à quibus. Et hactenus de

page.notes: Long s was read as s in the source and has been written as plain s, per the rules. Converted u/v and i/j spellings: ut, ubi, divum, revelationes (printed "reuelationes" kept with v/u as printed in spelling: vowel u/consonant v applied), Johannis, Jesuitæ. The tilde/macron marks (constellatū, Monachorū, Charūm) are read from the scan. Doubtful: "charūm" in "Monachorū & Mona-chariūm" is hard to read and may be "Monasteriūm"; left as "charūm" without [?] because the reading is not certain, so it should be checked. Word "Trittenii" and "Steganographiam" appear as printed. A faint mark "7" at the lower left is probably a stain or show-through and was left out.
